goal: Add the standalone pure changed-path task-tier classifier requested by GitHub Issue #19. The classifier accepts concrete canonical changed paths and declared TaskIntent risk, uses one exported centrally editable prefix list for Kernel, Pi extension, Spec, and TaskIntent paths, and returns the higher of the path-derived floor and declared tier. Preserve the existing glob-capable scope_hint risk floor and all current Review routing; Issue #20 owns input filtering, dynamic re-evaluation, and Review-obligation wiring.

acceptance.assertion: A standalone pure changed-path classifier and one exported material-floor prefix list resolve ordinary routine paths as routine, every configured prefix and descendant as at least material without near-prefix false positives, declared critical as critical, and declared routine cannot lower a matched path below material, while existing scope_hint parser behavior remains unchanged.
